paragraph_content.content: Abstract. We prove a formula of Dale Peterson comparing Gromov-Witten (GW) invariants of
An unpublished formula of Dale Peterson describes how 3-point, genus 0 Gromov-Witten invariants of

. Our purpose in this note is to describe an explanation, and in particular a proof, of this formula using ideas from moduli of principal bundles over curves. The quantum product with respect to the Schubert basis in

can be computed either recursively using Peterson’s quantum Chevalley formula, proved in [7], or using polynomial representatives for the Schubert classes in the Givental-Kim presentation of the small quantum cohomology [5], [13]. Together these results give a practicable method for computing the small quantum cohomology in the Schubert basis for arbitrary
, although there are much more effective methods in many special cases [2, 3, 4, 12, 11, 15].
